acquire.detail: Defeat the Yiga Clan members occupying the former Akkala Ancient Tech Lab, then talk to Konba inside.

acquire.title: Yiga hideout, Great Plateau
acquire.detail: Defeat the Yiga Clan members at their shack on the Great Plateau (south of the Temple of Time ruins), then talk to Pitar inside.

acquire.title: Yiga Clan Maritta Branch
acquire.detail: Clear the Yiga Clan Maritta Branch (Great Hyrule Forest region), Ascend through the square hole in the ceiling, then talk to Aliza.

acquire.title: Scorching Coliseum (Depths)
acquire.detail: Chest in the Scorching Coliseum in the Eldin Canyon Depths; clear the waves of Moblins to open it.

acquire.title: Lightcast Island (Sky)
acquire.detail: Chest in a cave on Lightcast Island in the Tabantha Frontier Sky; break the wall, solve the light-and-mirror puzzle, then Ascend to the chest. Reached by flying from Rospro Pass Skyview Tower.

acquire.title: Floating sphere near Sky Mine (Sky)
acquire.detail: Chest inside a floating hollow sphere near the Sky Mine in the Akkala Sea Sky (near Gikaku Shrine); get a giant cube onto its switch platform so you can Ascend inside.

acquire.title: Zonaite Forge Island (Sky)
acquire.detail: Chest on Zonaite Forge Island in the East Necluda Sky; the route needs the Zora Armor to swim up a sky waterfall, then a Zonai Hydrant platform over the lava and Ascend to the chest.

acquire.title: Restoring the Zora Armor
acquire.detail: Yona in Zora's Domain gives it to you once you bring her an Ancient Arowana during 'Restoring the Zora Armor' (part of the Sidon of the Zora storyline).

acquire.title: A Token of Friendship
acquire.detail: After clearing the Water Temple, take Yona's side adventure 'A Token of Friendship'; in the drained Ancient Zora Waterworks, go through the newly opened hole to a hidden chest behind the waterfall.

acquire.title: Floating Scales Island (Sky)
acquire.detail: Chest in a sludge-covered gap at the northern end of Floating Scales Island's tail, a sky island above Lanayru Great Spring. The side adventure 'The Never-Ending Lecture' points to it, but it can be taken at any time.
